publisher: Commonwealth of Australia, Bureau of Meteorology
temporal_currency: Geofabric V3.3 service; Bureau attribution year 2022; foundation inputs include ANUDEM 5.3.0 (3 November 2016) and AusHydro V2
feature_scale: approximately 1:100,000 foundation mapping; layer scale rules vary

layers.name: AHGFNetworkStream - All
layers.limitation: Network streams are derived raster/vector network features informed by AusHydro V2; they are not observed flow, water availability, flood or supply evidence.

layers.name: AHGFContractedCatchment
layers.limitation: Contracted catchments aggregate lower-level catchments to persistent contracted nodes; they do not establish drinking-water supply catchments.

layers.name: AHGFCatchment (SH_Catchments)
layers.limitation: These are stream-segment catchments derived from 1-second DEM-S and are labelled subcatchment context only for visual distinction in this project.

layers.name: AHGFWaterbody (SH_Cartography)
layers.limitation: Cartographic waterbody presence and names do not establish current storage, quality, capacity or availability.
